title: Rules & Info
description: The server welcome page: rules, values, raiding, events, history and ranks.
posts:
# 🔥 Welcome to From the Ashes
-# Hellfire EU · Founded 2008 · Community-first World of Warcraft guild

*This Discord is the hub of our community. Take a moment to get familiar with the layout, you'll get a lot more out of it.*

## ⚠️ Guild & Discord Rules
Breaking these may result in a warning, mute or ban, with or without notice.

- **No hate speech** - zero tolerance for racism, sexism, bigotry or discrimination of any kind
- **No bullying or harassment** toward any community member
- **No spam or unsolicited advertising** - channel or DM. Announcements require @Flamekeeper or @Officer approval
- **No content that breaks UK/EU law, Discord's ToS or Blizzard's ToS**
- **Everyone has to like the GM. And the GM has to like you** 🙂

@Flamekeeper & @Officer decision is final. @Guild Master's decision is **extra** final.
-# *Rules may be updated at any time* - To report a breach, DM a Flamekeeper or Officer.

## 💛 Our Values
We welcome people from all walks of life. In return we ask everyone to uphold these:

- Treat every community member with respect and consideration
- Be patient with newer or less experienced players
- Share your knowledge and help others enjoy the game
- Have fun and help others do the same
- Keep NSFW content and off-topic chat to the relevant channels

## 👥 Member Expectations
We have **no mandatory requirements** for general members. No pressure to attend events, socialise, or even have a character in the guild. Play as much or as little as you like.

*The community is built by its members - get involved as much as you want to.*

## ⚔️ Progression Raiding - Team Chemistry
Team Chemistry is our Cutting Edge progression team raiding **Wednesday & Sunday at 20:15 CET**.
TWW S1 4/8M by @RaidLeader
TWW S2 3/8M by @RaidLeader
TWW S3 6/8M by @OfficerTwo

*For trial enquiries, message @OfficerTwo directly.*

## 📅 Events & Sign-ups
All guild events require a sign-up so we can manage teams, rosters and invites.

- Sign-ups are always in [#event-signups](https://discord.com/channels/)
- Each event has its own thread for discussion
- **@Raid-Helper#3806** doesn't allow sign-ups in threads - always use the correct channel

**What's on:**
- **Casual Raid** - relaxed, community-focused runs open to everyone · contact @OfficerOne
- **M+ Keys** - push groups and learner runs in a safe, supportive environment
- **Fun Runs** - legacy content, social nights and chill gameplay

# 🏰 Guild History
Founded in 2008 during Wrath of the Lich King, Ashes began as a small group of family and friends. After quiet years through MoP and WoD and yes, a brief life as an alt bank. We were reborn in Dragonflight with open doors for new and returning players. In 2023 we opened our community to the world, hit 300+ members, and achieved our first Cutting Edge in Midnight.

From ashes, we rise, together. 🔥

## 🎖️ Ranks
Update your Discord name to match your in-game character - e.g. Emberwing (Sam). This helps us know who you are and get you the right role.

**Visitor** - non-guild member, friend or pug
**Ashes** - Guild member. No requirements, just play and enjoy.
**Ember** - Active community contributor. You make this place better. (by merit)
**Flame** - The heart of FtA. Embodies everything we stand for. (by merit)
**Flamekeeper** - community support team, trusted members keeping FtA running.
**Officer & GM** - guild and community leadership
